Quick finance read: reviewed the forecast and assumptions in Aventis_Forecast_Q4.xlsx. Summary below — conservative view.

- If 25% applies to list token price: expected gross margin over 12 months falls to ~28% given current infra/egress estimates. That is below our preferred strategic margin floor for new large accounts (we target >=35%).
- Conditional approval path: approve up to 25% off if
  * Commitment amended to 12 months (procurement requested)
  * Monthly spend cap for Q1 at $120k with automatic re-evaluation at month 3 based on actual consumption vs forecast
  * An overage price band: overages above cap billed at list minus 5% (i.e., not fully list) until month 4, at which point standard list prices apply if no renegotiation
  * Customer agrees to marketplace pilot NDA and PR opt-in clause (reduce sales/marketing CAC)

Notes on implementation: add a clear true-up clause (quarterly) and require a minimum 60-day notice before any billing tier change. We should also exclude any unmetered test environments from counted tokens — CS to set tooling limits at onboarding.

If we accept the above controls, finance is prepared to recommend Ben for final ratification. I can prepare the exact margin calc for Ben's review (2–3 hour turnaround).

—Mina
VP, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
